candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Body text is accurate. The closing dash in 糸井's line is rendered as 'ーー' (katakana long-vowel marks) instead of '――'. Omits the dotted underlines and the 1/2 question markers under つまり and 結果として, and the margin line numbers. Dialogue as a bullet list is acceptable; half-width digits and parentheses are minor.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text is accurate, with the correct dash and full-width digits. Speaker names are bolded, which is a reasonable choice. Omits the dotted underlines and the 1/2 markers under つまり and 結果として, and the margin line numbers. Furigana is given inline in parentheses.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: The only candidate to capture the 1 and 2 annotation markers on つまり and 結果として, as superscripts, though without the underline itself. Changes the footnote mark '*1' to '※1' and adds '：' after speaker names, which is not in the image. （中略） is wrongly placed as a list item. Body text is otherwise accurate.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Text is accurate, and paragraph indentation is preserved with full-width spaces. Dialogue is set as separate paragraphs, faithful to the layout. Omits the dotted underlines and the 1/2 markers, and the margin line numbers. Bolding 'CD1 Track 7' is harmless.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Text is accurate. The footnote mark is rendered as full-width '＊１', which is acceptable. CD1/Track/7 is split over three lines, and parentheses are a mix of half- and full-width. Omits the dotted underlines and the 1/2 markers, and the margin line numbers.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the body text essentially without error, so the ranking turns on small differences. C ranks first because it alone keeps the 1 and 2 markers attached to the underlined phrases, which matter for the textbook's questions; this outweighs its added colons and the '※' substitution. D comes next for clean text and layout-faithful paragraphing with indentation. B is equally accurate, with sensible bolding of speaker names. E is accurate but slightly less tidy in the CD label and punctuation widths. A is last because it replaces the dash with 'ーー', a real character error, and also omits the markers.
